rules.reason: Blue Cut blocks harmful blue-violet light (380-450nm) from screens. Better designed than traditional anti-glare for digital eye strain.
Anti-Glare reduces headlight reflections for night driving. Polarized eliminates road glare for daytime driving.
Polarized eliminates surface glare. Photochromic lenses adapt to changing light conditions automatically.
Most cost-effective upgrade at Rs 50/€5. Reduces reflections and improves lens appearance.
Premium multi-layer coating with better scratch resistance and easier cleaning than standard Anti-Glare.
Thin lenses (1.56-1.61 index) provide good slimming for moderate prescriptions.
Extra-Thin (1.67+ index) significantly reduces edge thickness for high powers. Better aesthetics.
Standard complimentary lenses work for all prescriptions. Optiwar team may upgrade at their own cost if higher index is needed.
Progressive lenses are the modern, advanced multifocal option with seamless no-line design. Recommended over bifocals.
Traditional two-zone lenses available for customers who prefer them. KT (Rs 250) is more affordable than D (Rs 500).
Presbyopia (age-related near vision loss) is best corrected with progressive lenses for seamless multi-distance vision.
